mapper.select: select * from eng_article_progress where user_id=#{userId} and article_id=#{articleId}
mapper.insert: insert into eng_article_progress(user_id,article_id,best_score,best_correct_count,best_total_count,completed,create_by,create_time,update_by,update_time) values(#{userId},#{articleId},#{bestScore},#{bestCorrectCount},#{bestTotalCount},#{completed},#{createBy},now(),#{updateBy},now()) on duplicate key update best_correct_count=if(values(best_score)>best_score,values(best_correct_count),best_correct_count), best_total_count=if(values(best_score)>best_score,values(best_total_count),best_total_count), completed=greatest(completed,values(completed)), update_by=if(values(best_score)>best_score,values(update_by),update_by), update_time=if(values(best_score)>best_score,now(),update_time), best_score=greatest(best_score,values(best_score))
mapper.select: select count(*) from eng_article_progress where user_id=#{userId} and completed=1
